4. The trial court decreed the suit in part allotting separate saham of 1.0½ acres of land to the plaintiffs, a separate saham of .79½ acre of land to the defendant No. 1 and another separate saham of .53 acre of land to the defendant Nos. 2 and 5 by the judgment and order dated 14.02.2000. 

 6. Being aggrieved by this judgment and decree of the appellate court below the defendant No. 1 filed the above mentioned 2 Civil Revision Nos. 1295 of 2003 and 1253 of 2003 before the High Court Division and obtained rule. Ultimately a Single Bench of the High Court Division, by the impugned judgment and order made both those rules absolute in part allotting a separate saham of 1.02½ acres of land to the plaintiffs and a separate saham of 1.79½ acres of land to the defendant No. 1. The High Court Division did not allot any saham to the defendant Nos. 2 and 5.
